scope: Independent read-only review of final combination against PR435 base; production Lua diff and named cross-module interactions, informed by existing five domain reviews. No full test rerun or heavy Lua; current head CI and campaign runtime belong to controller.

reviewedInteractions.assessment: Resource hints retain resourceAction early branch and canManagePotions guard (opening cover, disabled, same run, exit/deck/choice, busy, settlement, mode and phase). Disabled help/run_help applies independently to both pointer and Controller availability; neither kind is resource_. Existing generation/run/deck/potion/mode token checks remain. Menu layout hides help and closes its row without removing map/rule/abandon actions.

reviewedInteractions.area: touch card carry and PR435 recenter
reviewedInteractions.assessment: Only touchScreen aiming bypasses parking. Existing dragPose preserves pickup grab offset, eases it over first 80px toward +270*sourceScale, and continues centering toward pointer X. Mouse aiming retains g.origin[1] column and previous floor Y. Enemy hit, reticle, preview and release remain based on authoritative g.x/g.y, not lifted card pose.

reviewedInteractions.area: map XY distance and Y scrolling
reviewedInteractions.assessment: X/Y use same validated canvas scale; finite missing-X compatibility remains. Euclidean start threshold cancels horizontal and diagonal taps; scroll delta remains only Y. Release samples move, including Up-only motion. touch+slot ownership, node exclusivity, same-ID background recovery, context/generation validity and one-shot released grant are retained unchanged.

Observer runs after pcall success and nested-failure poison checks, before staged publication. Complete mutable graph copy preserves alias; nested commands mutate same staged owner. Observer uses no RNG/UID allocation. Existing upgrade-card hooks explicitly record eggs, camp, Tiny House, War Paint/Whetstone and Astrolabe fresh UID replacement. Real transforms remove old UID and obtain new UID. Identity+upgraded/count validation clears stale provenance; view repeats validation. PR435 lastRelicUpgrade/lastRelicObtain receipt semantics remain, with origin record added beside same receipt. Failure path cannot publish staged receipt.

UI reads current combat counters during combat and persistent counters otherwise; bindBattle copies persistent and settlement copies back. Existing localId lookup preserved. Lizard Tail -1/-2 and limited-use count labels align with source. Read-only status does not trigger effects.

Statically verified extracted paintPotionContents body equals exact PR435 baseline body after removing one indent level. Call stays in same state-face loop after shell/rim writes; captured dependencies, PotionView, Theme and tones preserved. No changed visibility, source path, tint order or label semantics found.

Constructor closure renamed self to view while colon-method self remains correct Lua method receiver. render/fresh/bind closures use view; handlers call view methods. No dangling constructor self reference found in changed closures.

checks.result: Full production Lua delta against base inspected; config registers origin core and origin_view UI.
PASS: Python exact baseline/current potion body comparison after one indent removal.
git diff --check base..HEAD reports raw evidence log EOF and HTTP response CRLF whitespace; no production source whitespace errors. See informational note.

nonBlockingNotes.detail: git diff --check flags EOF blank line and CRLF/trailing whitespace in captured raw logs. Informational evidence-format note, not a new runtime defect; do not silently rewrite raw evidence as part of source review.

boundaries: No new Critical/Important integration finding found in reviewed scope. This is source approval only.
No official same-candidate PC/phone import, ready, native input, screenshots or platform capacity proof is supplied by this review; keep those UNVERIFIED. Simulator images remain simulator evidence.
No natural campaign result, card/relic acquisition completeness, current final CI success or Windows timeout repair is inferred from static inspection. Controller retains runtime checks.
Existing background/platform issue is outside this change and was not modified or claimed resolved.
Backlog CLI is unavailable in this reviewer environment (command not found); no Backlog changes.
No source, branch, task or push mutation; only this external review JSON written.
